body.intent: Builder, verifier, check and fixer guidance says: never sleep or poll, no single command longer than about four minutes, and a long command runs once in the background and is waited for once (afk execute.js rule). Evidence: verifier session p90 33.7m against a 3.7m median, builder p90 25-36m against about 4m (prompt-gap rec 6).
body.title: Command budget
